:::writing{variant="chat_message" id="48271"}
Cease all contact with me immediately. I have never sent you any message of the sort you are alleging. This is now the second time you have attempted to contact me outside the scope of our MDA agreement with false accusations that I have contacted you.

You clearly have another Bethany’s number saved in your phone, as your number is not even stored in my contacts and has already been blocked.

Your continued unwanted contact and repeated false accusations are considered harassment. Any further communication outside the terms and obligations of our agreement will be documented accordingly.
:::
